crossRefs.note: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.
I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.” ’
Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahweh your God, and have scattered your ways to the…
that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more, because of your shame, when I have…
Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you…
Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when…
Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

translations.web: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
translations.bsb: The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
translations.kjv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
translations.asv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight: I am no more worthy to be called thy son.
